intent.description: Use this Agent Skill when a user provides a workflow, script, prompt, oral script, or concept brief and asks to turn it into a narrated concept-motion explainer video. It covers script freezing, measured voiceover, a canonical timeline, Remotion or HyperFrames motion, captions, rendering, and production handoff. Trigger on requests such as “把这段口播做成概念动效视频” or “用配音驱动字幕和画面”。Exclude script-only rewriting, caption-only work, existing-footage editing, reference-video analysis, and post-render quality audits; route the last case to `explainer-video-review`.
intent.job_to_be_done: 把脚本、工作流、口播稿或概念 brief 转成以配音为主时钟的概念动效解说视频，并输出可审查的生产交接包。
target_users: Remotion 或 HyperFrames 实现者
inputs: 口播脚本、观点文案、工作流、产品说明或概念 brief
平台、比例、帧率、声线、视觉风格和交付格式（可选）
已有 Remotion / HyperFrames 工程与资源（可选）
outputs: 实测配音、句级 cue、canonical timeline.json 和字幕数据
场景实现、可播放 MP4 和生产交接证据
exclusions: 成片发布后的独立质量审查

should_trigger: 把这段口播脚本做成带配音、字幕和概念动效的解说视频
把这个观点工作流封装成脚本到概念动效视频的 Skill，并用音频 cue 驱动时间轴
用 Remotion 根据配音实测时长生成 timeline.json、字幕和场景动画
把这份产品说明制作成可观看的中文概念解说视频，最后交给 review Skill 检查
should_not_trigger: 只改写这篇文章的口播文案，不做视频
给已有实拍素材只做字幕，不改变画面
做参考视频分析，拆解镜头和剪辑节奏
只审查成片的字幕和画面问题，输出问题清单
near_neighbor: 分析这个已有 MP4 的视觉质量和音画同步
把一段已有实拍素材剪成带字幕的短视频
把文章压缩成 60 秒口播稿

router_rules: Trigger when the request turns a script, workflow, prompt, oral script, or concept brief into a narrated concept-motion explainer video.
Require a production artifact, not script-only rewriting, caption-only work, existing-footage editing, reference-video analysis, or post-render auditing.
Route post-render visual, subtitle, spatial-continuity, or audio-sync review to `../explainer-video-review/SKILL.md`.
compact_workflow: Freeze intent, script segments, platform, aspect ratio, and delivery format.
Produce and measure voiceover; record sentence-level cues.
Generate and validate `segments.json`, `timeline.json`, and subtitle data.
Route semantic concepts to motion resources and implement scenes in Remotion or HyperFrames.
Render representative frames, run production preflight, render the complete MP4, and hand off evidence.
gate_ladder: **Input gate**: intent, script, platform, and output format are known; unresolved conflicts are recorded.
**Audio gate**: voiceover is listenable and measured; cue boundaries are recorded.
**Timeline gate**: one canonical timeline passes structural validation.
**Render gate**: representative frames and the complete MP4 are rendered from that timeline.
**Review gate**: the companion review Skill receives the MP4, frozen sources, timeline, captions, and evidence bundle.
output_contract: Return frozen `segments.json`, measured voiceover and cues, canonical `timeline.json`, captions, scene implementation, rendered MP4, and handoff evidence.
Mark provider-render, playback, and human-review results as `missing evidence` until they are actually observed.
When a review finds a source or cue defect, repair the source, rerender the whole video, and submit a new evidence bundle.

trust.remote_metadata_policy: allow read-only source and catalog review; require explicit user input for external writes

permissions.network: source discovery, optional asset/license lookup, and explicitly configured providers
permissions.file_write: project working directory and target skill files only when requested
permissions.subprocess: Remotion, HyperFrames, FFmpeg, ffprobe, configured TTS, and bundled validation scripts
permissions.interactive: only for hard blockers or voice/render acceptance

scaffold: frontmatter has name, description, and explicit exclusions
README has natural-language triggers and a validation hook
audio-clock and handoff boundaries are stated
production: resources are routed by semantic topology
trigger cases cover positive, negative, and near-neighbor requests
runtime and human evidence claims are labeled
library: Skill IR and prior-art report are present
platform and degradation metadata are present
review cadence and owner are declared
governed: rollback, trust, secret, and publication boundaries are present

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
